relations.subject: Parathesey Sankaralingam
relations.evidence: Sankaralingam was the first Director of the Roja Muthiah Research Library in Madras, a position he held since September 1993

relations.subject: Parathesey Sankaralingam
relations.evidence: The University of Madras generously gave Sankaralingam a leave of absence to accept the Directorship of RMRL. From 1976 he had been a faculty member in the University's Department of Library and Information Science, most recently as a Senior Lecturer.

relations.subject: Parathesey Sankaralingam
relations.evidence: From 1968 through 1976, he was Assistant Librarian at the Tirunelveli Medical College, Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu.

relations.subject: Parathesey Sankaralingam
relations.evidence: His M.Lib.Sc. degree was from the University of Mysore in 1975.

relations.subject: Parathesey Sankaralingam
relations.evidence: He was a founding trustee of MOZHI, a public Trust for Resource Development in Language and Culture, and held that position until becoming Director of RMRL.
